record.question:
(a) Why is trivector meter so called?
(b) You are using 3-phase, 4-wire electronic energy meter designed for CT Ratio of 50/5A. But the actual CT Ratio of the feeder is 100/5A. Find out the Multiplying Factor to be used for taking the reading of the energy meter.
(c) A domestic consumer having connected load of 2kW is using MDI meter, the meter reading is as follows: Previous reading = 1234kWh and Present reading = 1436 kWh. Calculate the energy charge of his consumption as per existing rate of tariff in Mizoram, i.e., (i) Fixed charge is Rs 35/- per month per kW of contracted load (ii) First 50 kWh @ Rs 2.35 per kWh (ii) Next 50 kWh @ Rs 3.25 per kWh (iii) Next 100 kWh @ 4.20 per kWh (iv) Above 200kWh @ 4.80 per kWh. What will be the amount of rebate he can avail as per existing tariff in force?
